title: Cool Froots
tagline: The Cool Froots are a dynamic NFT collectible with the super power to speak to the world!
description:
We have seen NFT collectibles with awesome roadmaps and lots of utility but what NFTs today lack is individual personalisation. Cool Froots change that game every holder can change the txt message in his NFTs speech bubble !

The Cool Froots are a PFP collectible where users are able to edit the token text message in the speech bubble at any time.  You have to keep your fruits fresh  with ICE otherwise flys will conquer your token we gamified the whole Token itself and have lots of cool activities and games for our holders on the roadmap.
